body: Bloodhound member Poohman was shot & killed after leaving Q50’s funeral Police claim he was spotted at a gas station on 76th & Cottage, when 2 men pulled up and began firing shots at him. He got in his Challenger & sped away as they continued shooting at him. He crashed into a pole on 74th & Cottage Bloodhoundq50 Chicago Beef.
